item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Not bad. I didn't like it enough to upvote, but I feel it was good enough to save it from a downvote. I feel like there was a bit too much build-up and not that much pay-off. WARNING: PERSONAL OPINIONS AND SUGGESTIONS AHEAD. The narrative of the childhood was a little bland; I would personally make it more meaningful and interesting by possibly changing the tone, maybe to, for example, emptily melancholy or happy naïvety. Also, it really feels like you just skimmed over what could possibly be the most interesting part of the story when you just briefly hint at the acquisition of the teeth.

To recap: Not bad, but could be better. No vote.

As a sidenote, the description reminded me of the Lilo and Stitch doll.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Thanks for the comment man, again much appreciated.

For your first question, I'm afraid, I can't tell you, it would kind of ruin the nature of my SCP, and I find it would be a lovely cliffhanger, so all I can say for now is, wait and see.

Why teeth? I guess I always had a kind of shiver at the thought of people collecting teeth, its one of the things I truely dread. But your question could be interpretated in another form, why does "Ick" collect teeth?, well, I think I hinted at why Ick collects teeth in the short story, but I drafted it so much, I might have edited it out, but if I have, then, I know people hate this but.. its a nice cliffhanger.

item.content:encoded:
I have to ask, even though I'm spoiling it somewhat; does the little doll entity ACTUALLY play the part of some cosmic keystone? Or does it simply make this poor retch THINK it does?

Also… Why teeth? We have a few other tooth-ridden things in containment right now, maybe it just generally likes shed things. Hair and nails in a pinch, teeth because they come out naturally, but oh, that big bloated thing with the tentacles is getting closer, you don't REALLY need that pinky do you? Oh you do? Well you better go get me something…

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Firstly, thanks man for your comment, much appreciated.

Secondly, to answer some of your confusions, no, this is not a current SCP, it is a SCP I am currently working on, I came up with the idea when I was writing this short story for a project, I decided after finding this site a while ago to try and make it into a full-blown SCP. This short story as I explained in my first comment was "gathering dust on my desktop", and I thought it might be a good way to introduce the SCP before it was released for all to see. Due to the SCP not existing as of now, I have changed the tags from "tale" to "creepypasta" as of your thoughts.

As with all tales or creepypasta on this site, I believe, they are up for interpretation and this is no exception. All people have their fears, thats a given, and mine is in the form of a crude ragdoll, I had as a child. Everyone elses on this site may differ, and thats awesome, it's what this site is built on, various fears potrayed in realistic manners.

Anyways, I went on a tangent, thanks for your thoughts they are much appreciated.

item.content:encoded:
Unless this relates to an SCP I'm not familiar with, I believe this should be tagged "creepypasta" rather than "tale".

As for the content itself, eh. It's a sock puppet what eats teeth and blackmails you into giving it teeth out of fear that it will let (i.e. cause) Hell on Earth to happen. Maybe if I were ever afraid that the bounds of reality itself were coming unglued, I'd find the protagonist a little more relatable. As is, well, eh.

item.title: Preview
item.content:encoded:
This "tale" is a preview of sorts for an SCP I have been working on, I finished this short story a while ago, and it was gathering dust on my desktop. I thought it might be a nice way to introduce my "creation" before it is released. Anyways, all comments are appreciated.

Thanks guys and gals.
